『機動戦士ガンダム ＴＨＥ ＯＲＩＧＩＮ』ＭＳＤ（Ｍｏｂｉｌｅ Ｓｕｉｔ Ｄｉｓｃｏｖｅｒｙ）より
「ジム」バリエーション系譜に連なるジム・ガードカスタム（Ｅ-２ビーム・スプレーガン装備）がＨＧキットで商品化！
胸部やランドセルをはじめとする部位を新規造形で再現し、特徴的なＥ-２ビーム・スプレーガンが付属。
●　特徴的な機体形状を新規造形を交え再現
胸部、ランドセル、肩部、腰部など全身の各所にわたる変更点を新規造形で再現。
・ランドセル
バルカン砲が特徴的なランドセルを新規造形で再現。
・肩部、胸部、腰部、脚部装甲
機体各所を新規造形を交え再現。
腰部　新規造形のサイドスカートはＥ-２ビーム・スプレーガンを装着可能。
●　Ｅ-２ビーム・スプレーガンや平手パーツなど豊富なオプションパーツが付属
新規造形のＥ-２ビーム・スプレーガンは２丁付属。さらにポージングの幅が広がる平手ハンドパーツが左右それぞれ分付属。
●　コーションマークをはじめとした各種マーキングシールが付属
付属武装：Ｅ-２ビーム・スプレーガン ／ ビーム・スプレーガン ／ ビーム・ダガー ／ ガーディアン・シールド

en: Jim Guard Custom (equipped with E-2 beam spray gun)
From “Mobile Suit Gundam THE ORIGIN” MSD (Mobile Suit Discovery)
Jim Guard Custom (equipped with E-2 beam spray gun), which is connected to the "Gym" variation lineage, is commercialized with HGKit!
Parts including the chest and school bag have been recreated with new modeling, and the characteristic E-2 beam spray gun is included.
● Reproduce the characteristic aircraft shape with new modeling
Changes to various parts of the body such as the chest, school bag, shoulders, and waist are reproduced with new modeling.
·school bag
The school bag featuring the Vulcan cannon is reproduced with a new model.
・Shoulder, chest, waist, leg armor
Reproduce various parts of the aircraft with new modeling.
Waist: The newly sculpted side skirts can be equipped with an E-2 beam spray gun.
● Comes with a variety of optional parts such as E-2 beam spray gun and open hand parts.
Two newly designed E-2 beam spray guns are included. Furthermore, open hand parts for left and right hands are included to expand the range of poses.
● Comes with various marking seals including caution marks.
Attached weapons: E-2 Beam Spray Gun / Beam Spray Gun / Beam Dagger / Guardian Seal
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo is painted. Also, a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
*Please note that some of the clear parts may contain air bubbles due to the manufacturing process.
